trickyParts: migrationid.Check derives the numbered series from the set: values below 10^13 must be exactly 1..N for the N present; values from 10^13 up must be real 14-digit UTC instants. It re-checks neither duplicates nor < 1, which both loaders refuse.
The auto-deployer records <max>-<count>-<sha256 of the sorted versions>; a bare-number record from the previous deployer is still compared by max while its tag stays deployed.
autodeploy_test.sh's locale precondition needs en_US.UTF-8; in the pod it was generated under $TMPDIR and passed as LOCPATH (the suite stops before any case without it, on main too).
